text.tspan: Adding a field is a row, not a migration
A user field registered from the shell is immediately valid to set, filterable by the query grammar, and offered as a column in the browser, with no schema change and no frontend change.
Owner user, so the API may create and delete it; core and provider fields are not editable this way.
Validate the definition against the field-property
Insert the fields row; the registry reloads
The same path a core field takes. There is no second write route for user fields.
The browser runs this identical pure function before
sending, so a bad value never leaves the client.
Merge into the entry's attributes document
Parse the clause; an unknown key errors with the

Components read the registry, so the browser learns the
field the moment it is registered.
